wiktionary.gloss: A thin, narrow strip or bar of wood (lath), metal, or plastic.

A ski.
A thin piece of stone; a slate.
A drop (of rain or water), a splash.

blocks.etymology: From Middle English slatte, sklatte, sklat, sclat, from Old French esclat (“piece broken or split off, shiver, splinter”), from Old French esclater (“to split, burst”), from Frankish *slaitijan (“to split, break”), from Proto-Germanic *slītaną (“to rend, split”). Doublet of slate and éclat.

examples: I took the tube to Waterloo and walked the rest of the way.
